content: मुह् €4 <ab>P.</ab> (मुह्यति, मुग्ध or मूढ) .²1 To faint, swoon, lose consciousness, become senseless; इहाहं द्रष्टुमाह्वं तां स्मरन्नेवं मुमोह सः <ls>Bk. 6. 21</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">1. 20</ls>, <ls n="Bk.">15. 16</ls>. .²2 To be perplexed or bewildered, to be disturbed in mind, be at a loss; आपस्त्वपि न मुह्यन्ति नराः पण्डितबुद्धयः <ls>H. 1. 145</ls>; <ls>Ki. 18. 9</ls>. .²3 To be foolish, stupid, or infatuated. .²4 To fail. .²5 To err, mistake. --{%<ab>Caus.</ab>%} (मोहयति-ते) .²1 To stupefy, infatuate; मा मूमुहत् खलु भवन्तमनन्यजन्मा <ls>Māl. 1. 32</ls>. .²2 To confound, bewilder, perplex; व्यामिश्रेणेव वाक्येन बुद्धिं मोहयसीव मे <ls>Bg. 3. 2</ls>, <ls n="Bg.">4. 16</ls>. .²3 To throw into confusion. .²4 To cause to err or mistake.
